uutiset.t: Putin's Crimean Bridge partly collapses as Zelensky hails 'unprecedented' attack by Ukraine
uutiset.s: Ukraine says the missile and drone attack on the strategic bridge in the Russian-annexed Crimea took weeks to plan.

uutiset.t: Russian military plane crashes killing all 19 on board
uutiset.s: Russia's defence ministry says it preliminarily believes a technical malfunction was the cause of the crash in the Kemerovo region.

uutiset.t: US loses measles elimination status after 26 years amid record case numbers
uutiset.s: States have reported over 5,400 cases and 10 measles-related deaths for the first time since the early 1990s.

uutiset.t: American soldier arrested by UK police on suspicion of spying taken into US military custody
uutiset.s: The Metropolitan Police say he has been taken into custody by the US Military over suspected national security and espionage allegations.

uutiset.t: Palestinian woman, 72, shot dead by Israeli settlers in West Bank, health ministry says
uutiset.s: Palestinians say there was an attack by settlers in al-Duyuk al-Tahta, while the Israeli military says the settlers fired after being attacked.

uutiset.t: Trump in Asia ahead of talks with Russian and Chinese presidents
uutiset.s: The US president said he would be open to a one-on-one meeting with Russia's Vladimir Putin "if it's available".

uutiset.t: Carney looks to China as Trump tariffs squeeze Canada's car industry
uutiset.s: The PM has suggested Chinese automakers could replace American ones in Canada - but some say that would not be easy.

uutiset.t: UK sanctions firms over Israeli West Bank settlements
uutiset.s: It marks the first sanctions since the UK announced a tougher approach to Israeli actions in the territory.

uutiset.t: Jensen Huang says he would be 'honoured' to return as Nvidia CEO if board asked him
uutiset.s: Huang says he has had an "outpouring" of calls from investors and others calling for him to return.

uutiset.t: William and Kate celebrate Earthshot Prize winners in Mumbai
uutiset.s: The Prince and Princess of Wales were joined by sporting and acting stars for the annual environmental awards ceremony.

uutiset.t: Who to watch in Spain's election race
uutiset.s: Spain votes on 29 November, with the conservatives and the far right favourites to win after eight years of Socialist-led rule.

uutiset.t: Trump says US taking 'very seriously' any Iranian plot against Washington
uutiset.s: Tehran rejects any suggestion it was plotting a so-called dirty bomb attack on the US capital as "baseless".

uutiset.t: 'It was really scary': Mother describes sheltering during Russia strikes on Kyiv bridge
uutiset.s: Moscow has targeted bridges in Kyiv, while Ukraine severely damaged a critical bridge linking Russia to occupied Crimea.

uutiset.t: BBC reports from Kyiv bridge hit by Russian attack
uutiset.s: The BBC's Sarah Rainsford spoke to residents near the site of the overnight strike.

uutiset.t: How the attack on Crimean Bridge unfolded
uutiset.s: One of the key symbols of Russia's occupation of Ukraine has suffered major damage after a seven-stage attack by Kyiv.
